<thought>Based on the mass‑spectrometry data, the most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199.0, which in positive‑mode ESI typically corresponds to the [M + H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of about 198 Da. A plausible molecular formula that matches this mass is C₁₀H₁₄O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14O2</final_answer>
